title: Get additional interest categories
content_data:
Use this group of endpoints to get additional interest categories (interest keywords). Note that only effective additional interest categories (`status` = `EFFECTIVE`) can be used in ad groups to target audiences. - If you want to search for additional interest categories based on seed keywords, see [/tool/interest_keyword/recommend/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?rid=7xusz43oh3h&id=1763590884474882). - If you want to use IDs to get additional interest categories, see [/tool/interest_keyword/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?rid=7xusz43oh3h&id=1763590894544897). > **Important**
Please use the keyword tool responsibly. You are responsible for your targeting decisions, including their legal compliance.
